slots.short: Branded crew + wrapped truck in front of a finished home
slots.prompt: Real crew photo: 2-4 painters in branded shirts standing by the company-wrapped truck, parked in front of a freshly painted two-story home. Shot at golden hour or bright overcast. Camera at chest height, wide angle. Fallback if no crew photo exists: a clean exterior 'after' shot of the best local project.
slots.specs: Landscape 16:9, min 2400x1350px. Keep the right two-thirds visually calm - headline, trust chips and the quote form sit on top. Site adds a dark navy overlay (40-60%), so avoid photos that are already dark.
slots.dont: No stock photos of random American houses that don't match the local housing stock. No busy skies or harsh noon shadows. No photos where faces are cut off.
slots.search: Client jobsite photo required (this slot builds trust). Stock is a last resort: 'house painters crew truck exterior'.

slots.area: Team or owner photo (video thumbnail optional)
slots.short: Team group photo in branded shirts, or owner portrait
slots.prompt: Whole crew lined up in front of the branded truck on a lawn, matching company shirts, natural smiles (Pro Vision style). Solo operators: professional owner portrait, chest-up, branded polo, soft background (ACS 'David Kuczynski' style). If a company-story video exists, this image becomes the play-button thumbnail.
slots.specs: 4:3 or 3:2 landscape, min 1200x900px. Faces sharp, evenly lit. Leave breathing room above heads for the play button overlay.
slots.dont: No sunglasses hiding eyes, no cluttered backgrounds (dumpsters, competitors' signage), no group shots taken from far away where faces are unrecognizable.
slots.search: Client photo required - never stock. People buy from people; a stock 'team' destroys trust.

slots.area: Action photo beside the 'Ready to get started?' form
slots.short: Painters on ladders actively working an exterior
slots.prompt: Mid-action shot: one painter high on an extension ladder cutting in siding or trim, a second painter working lower - shows scale, safety and real work happening (Legacy uses exactly this). Branded shirts visible if possible.
slots.specs: Landscape 4:3, min 1600x1200px. Subject slightly right-of-center. Sharp focus on the painters, not the ladder hardware.
slots.dont: No posed 'pretending to paint' stock shots, no unsafe ladder positions (dev: this photo signals professionalism - OSHA-sketchy photos cost jobs).
slots.search: Client jobsite photo preferred. Stock fallback: 'professional painter extension ladder house siding'.

slots.short: Bright finished living room, natural light, neutral walls
slots.prompt: Finished interior 'after': bright staged living room with freshly painted walls in a warm neutral, big window light, minimal furniture so the WALLS are the hero. Legacy and Pro Vision both use this exact look.
slots.specs: Landscape 4:3, min 900x675px (cards render ~430px wide, retina x2).
slots.dont: No dark moody interiors, no rooms where furniture hides the walls, no wide-angle distortion bending door frames.
slots.search: Client 'after' photo preferred. Stock OK: 'bright living room freshly painted neutral walls natural light'.

slots.short: Full house 'after' with blue sky, curb-appeal angle
slots.prompt: Complete house exterior after repaint, shot from the front corner at a slight angle (not dead-on), blue sky or bright overcast, lawn mowed. The house style must match the local market (e.g. Virginia colonials for Legacy, Florida stucco/siding for Pro Vision).
slots.specs: Landscape 4:3, min 900x675px. Whole house in frame with a little sky above the roofline.
slots.dont: No cars blocking the house, no trash bins, no seasonal mismatch (snow photos on a Florida site).
slots.search: Client project photo preferred. Stock OK: 'two story home fresh exterior paint blue sky'.

slots.short: Close-up detail: white shaker cabinets or crisp trim line
slots.prompt: Detail shot that proves craftsmanship: freshly painted white/light kitchen cabinets (Pro Vision) or a crisp crown-molding / trim paint line against a colored wall (Legacy). This is the 'zoom-in' card among wide shots - keep it tight.
slots.specs: Landscape 4:3, min 900x675px. Razor-sharp focus on the paint edge or cabinet doors.
slots.dont: No brush-stroke texture visible, no caulk gaps, no cluttered countertops in cabinet shots.
slots.search: Client photo preferred. Stock OK: 'white shaker cabinets freshly painted kitchen' or 'crown molding paint line detail'.

slots.prompt: A finished commercial job: small office building, storefront or apartment block exterior - clean lines, daytime (Legacy uses an apartment/office building). Signals 'we handle bigger jobs' to business owners.
slots.dont: No skyscrapers or big-city stock that doesn't match the service area - keep it believable for the local market.
slots.search: Client project photo preferred. Stock OK: 'small commercial building fresh paint storefront'.

slots.short: Freshly stained deck with rich wet-look wood tone
slots.prompt: Freshly stained wood deck, rich even color, ideally with railing and stairs visible (both Legacy and Pro Vision use this). Late-afternoon light makes stain glow.
slots.dont: No half-finished decks, no peeling 'before' photos in this slot - this card sells the after.
slots.search: Client photo preferred. Stock OK: 'freshly stained wood deck railing backyard'.

slots.short: Painted shed or garage with clean lines
slots.prompt: A painted garden shed or garage exterior with crisp, uniform color - Legacy uses a dark modern shed with a path leading to it. Any small-structure 'after' with good light works.
slots.dont: No cluttered yards, no vehicles blocking the structure.
slots.search: Client photo preferred. Stock OK: 'painted garden shed modern backyard'.

slots.short: Crew in branded gear working at a front door / prepping
slots.prompt: Candid, un-posed shot of two crew members in branded hoodies/shirts working together at a home's entry - taping, prepping or inspecting (Legacy's strongest photo: two painters at a blue door, logos readable on their backs). Authenticity over polish.
slots.specs: Landscape 4:3 or portrait 3:4, min 1200px on the long edge. Branding must be legible.
slots.dont: No faces required here - backs with logos actually work better. No staged handshakes, no hard-hat stock clichés.
slots.search: Client photo required - the branded clothing is the point. Stock cannot fake this.

slots.short: Dramatic exterior action: boom lift or tall ladder work
slots.prompt: The 'wow' shot: painter(s) on a boom lift or staging working a tall exterior wall (Legacy uses a green boom lift against a blue building). Conveys capability on big jobs. Sits on the right half of a dark navy banner behind a diagonal red paint-stroke crop.
slots.specs: Landscape, min 1600x900px. Key subject must live in the RIGHT half - the left half is covered by headline and buttons. Must read well at 50% darkened edges.
slots.dont: No tiny distant figures - the lift/ladder should fill the frame. Avoid warm/orange color casts that fight the navy+red brand palette.
slots.search: Client photo preferred. Stock fallback: 'painters boom lift building exterior'.

slots.short: Three best 'after' shots: house, deck/interior, commercial
slots.prompt: Three real, named projects - mirror Legacy's mix: (a) residential exterior repaint, (b) deck revival or interior transformation, (c) commercial/apartment job. Each gets a title + category caption over a dark bottom gradient. Alternative (Pro Vision pattern): before/after pairs - same angle, same height, same daylight for both frames.
slots.specs: Very wide crop ~21:9, min 2000x900px each - shoot loose so the wide crop doesn't decapitate roofs. Before/after pairs: min 1000px each, identical framing.
slots.dont: No mixing portrait and landscape in the row. Before/after: never different angles or lighting - it reads as fake.
slots.search: Client project photos ONLY. This section is the proof - stock here is lying to customers.

slots.short: Interior action: painter cutting in / rolling, clean site
slots.prompt: Painter actively cutting in a ceiling line or rolling a wall INSIDE a home or office, drop cloths visible, tidy workspace (Legacy uses a painter in a glass office interior). Shows care inside customers' homes.
slots.specs: Portrait 3:4 or landscape 4:3, min 1200px long edge.
slots.dont: No paint mess on floors, no ladders leaning on finished walls - the photo argues 'we respect your home'.
slots.search: Client photo preferred. Stock fallback: 'professional painter interior roller drop cloth'.

slots.short: Topic-matched images - must match the article AND the niche
slots.prompt: Each thumbnail must literally match its article topic: color-guide article gets a color-swatch or painted-room photo; prep article gets taping/masking; cost article gets an estimator or house exterior. NICHE CHECK: painting articles get painting images, roofing articles get roofs.
slots.dont: Found in the current drafts: interior living-room and laundry-cabinet photos used on ROOFING blog articles (ACS). Never let the thumbnail contradict the headline.
slots.search: Stock is fine here: match keywords to each article title.

slots.short: Live Google Maps embed centered on the ACTUAL service city
slots.prompt: Use a real Google Maps embed (not a screenshot) centered on the client's actual city with a branded pin. City chips above it must list the client's real service towns.
slots.specs: Full-width embed, ~500-650px tall, desaturated/light map style to match the design.
slots.dont: Found in the current drafts: the Jacksonville FL site (Pro Vision) shows a map of Mt Clemens, MICHIGAN - copied from the ACS file. Always re-center the embed per client.
slots.search: Google Maps embed API - no photo needed.

slots.short: Roofing sites: truck hero, crew-on-roof action, drone 'after'
slots.prompt: For roofing clients (ACS / Superior): hero = branded truck photo (ACS pattern); services action photo = crew installing shingles shot from roof level (ACS uses a great one on a multifamily building); gallery = drone or elevated 'after' shots of completed roofs; about = founder portrait. Same slot system, roofing subjects.
slots.specs: Same sizes as the painting equivalents (IMG-01, IMG-03, IMG-12, IMG-02).
slots.dont: No interior-design photos anywhere on a roofing site (see IMG-14 note). No stock roofs with architecture that doesn't exist in Michigan.
slots.search: Client jobsite + drone photos strongly preferred for roofing - roofs are hard to fake with stock.
